text:
Dmitri: Heads up — replay harness shows a p99 regression after the kernel-selector change we rolled yesterday on A10 nodes. Synthetic load (synth-bench) doesn't show it. Need eyes on env parity (drivers, CUDA, container flags, kernel params).
Maya: hm — do we have exact driver + cuda used by replay vs synth? could be nv/470 vs 525 mismatch.
Joel: I saw a note from deploy-bot: `image: rwinf/runtime:2026-03-12-kernelselector-v2` rolled to prod yesterday.
perf-bot: profile summary for replay run (A10, 2k reqs):
```
median latency: 42ms
p95: 120ms
p99: 450ms  <-- regressed +12% vs baseline
KV hit-rate: 78%
batch size dist: 1: 55%, 2: 30%, 4+: 15%
selected kernel: cuda_fused_attn_v2
```
Anika: can you dump `nvidia-smi -q` + `nvcc --version` from both nodes? also include `uname -a` and container image manifest.
Dmitri: attached logs from A10 replay node (short):
```
Driver Version: 470.199.02
CUDA Version: 11.4
glibc: 2.31
kernel cmdline: transparent_hugepage=never
```
Samir: synth-bench nodes show:
```
Driver Version: 525.60.13
CUDA Version: 12.1
glibc: 2.35
kernel cmdline: default
```
Ops-Liz: aha — different driver/CUDA combos. also synth image uses `rwinf/runtime:cuda12` while replay uses `rwinf/runtime:cuda11-compat` (we pin for older A10 AMI).
Maya: that could change kernel selection heuristics — some kernels only available/optimal on cuda12 libs.
perf-bot: I dumped kernel export list from both images:
```
cuda11 image: [cuda_fused_attn_v2, generic_attn]
cuda12 image: [cuda_fused_attn_v3, fused_attn_opt]
```
Anika: proposed steps:
- reproduce locally on an A10 / cuda11 image with small replay (owner: Dmitri)
- run `replay-harness --trace kernels --kv-metrics` and attach traces (owner: Dmitri)
- run synth-bench on same image + driver to confirm parity (owner: Joel)
- if repro, add kernel selector log + fallback policy to trace (owner: Maya)
Dmitri: running now, will post traces at ~1887654520.
Joel: also add env var `RW_KERNEL_FLAGS=prefer_generic` to force fallback for quick A/B.
Ops-Liz: I can spin identical AMIs with cuda12 and cuda11 for cross-check, ETA 2h.
Samir: quick idea — could KV caching behavior differ because of minor glibc/cuda allocator changes? worth checking the KV hit latency distribution.
Maya: yep — request `kv.hist` from perf bot for both runs.
perf-bot: kv.hist for replay (A10/cuda11): `p50 0.8ms p95 3.1ms p99 9.7ms`
perf-bot: kv.hist for synth (A10/cuda12): `p50 0.6ms p95 2.0ms p99 5.2ms`
Dmitri: big delta on kv p99 — could feed into tail latency.
Anika: if we confirm driver/CUDA is root cause, short-term mitigation: pin runtime image to cuda12 for replay lanes or add kernel selector fallback to fused_attn_v2 when v3 not available.
Maya: I'll open a tiny PR to add fallback config + extra logs.
Dmitri: thanks — will update when trace upload finishes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: image rollout note — `rwinf/runtime:2026-03-12-kernelselector-v2` -> rolled to A10 pool at 2026-03-12T09:12Z
Joel: action items recap: Dmitri run traces, Joel run synth on cuda11 image, Ops-Liz spin AMIs, Maya PR for fallback, Anika check glibc/allocator differences.
Dmitri: last upload done — traces at s3://rwinf-perf/replay/1887654321/trace.tar.gz
Maya: got it, starting analysis.
